g.text: Exploratory average-linkage clustering of ten method-level records. Reviews and conceptual-only tags are excluded.

g.text: Each cell shows similarity and the number of records reporting both methods. Clusters describe this selected working set.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #546371

g.text: Co-occurrence does not establish model coupling, causation or independent corroboration. Related author/study families remain a limitation.

g.text: Leave-one-record-out ranges are provided in the CSV. No significance test or stable architectural taxonomy is claimed.
